next_rupee: Manhole cover replaced and grating on Veer Nariman Road: Rs 45,000. Risk score 45.2, open for 16 days, serves a school and a bus route.
Hot mix patch on Shahid Bhagat Singh Marg: Rs 17,600. A pothole that came back after a repair, open for 72 days, serves a school and a bus route.

Hot mix patch on Colaba Causeway (rank 3): Rs 17,600. Pothole with 2 complaints, open for 18 days, serves a school. questions_to_ask: Under RTI, request the payment vouchers and DLP status for WO25-02424, WO25-00809, WO25-01482, WO25-00505, WO25-02019 and WO25-00399. Why was Rs 2.08 L paid while these roads were still under defect liability?

What site records, photos and completion certificates exist for WO25-02456 and WO25-00606? How will the ward fund the Rs 97,800 needed for open priorities when spend is already Rs 55,330 over budget?

next_rupee: Clear the 10 open issues, costing Rs 4.34L of the Rs 7.92L left. Start with the Mohammed Ali Road manhole (Rs 45,000) and waterlogging pump (Rs 60,000), since both are on an entry route to Sir JJ Hospital.
Fix the P D'Mello Road choked drain and nullah overflow near the Masjid Bunder East flood hotspot by desilting and garbage removal (Rs 70,000).

Which of the 10 open issues have a funded work order and a completion date, and how many of the 20.5% reopened jobs were repaired by the same contractor within the warranty period?
